name: ExpenseX
tagline: Track locally, keep safely. Your financial data stays on your device, not in the cloud.
description: A privacy-focused mobile application for tracking expenses and income completely offline.
detailedDescription: Most expense trackers upload your sensitive financial details to remote servers. ExpenseX keeps everything 100% on your device. No accounts, no cloud sync, no data mining. Just pure, personal finance tracking.
headline:
Cloud services are intrusive.
You need Private Control.

detailedFeatures.title: Day-to-Day Tracking
detailedFeatures.text: Effortlessly log every income and expense. Categorize transactions instantly to keep your daily finances organized and clear.

detailedFeatures.title: Monthly Reports
detailedFeatures.text: Visualize your spending habits with comprehensive monthly reports. Understand where your money goes with clear, locally-generated charts.

detailedFeatures.title: Budget Management
detailedFeatures.text: Set strict budgets for different categories. Get alerts when you're nearing your limits and stay on track with your financial goals.

detailedFeatures.title: Payment Methods
detailedFeatures.text: Track spending across cash, credit cards, and bank transfers. See exactly which payment method you use most frequently.

detailedFeatures.title: Excel Import/Export
detailedFeatures.text: Take control of your data. Easily export your logs to Excel for detailed analysis or import legacy data to get started immediately.

detailedFeatures.title: Device Secure
detailedFeatures.text: Your data never leaves your phone. Security is guaranteed by your device's physical access controls and OS-level sandboxing.

points.title: Local Storage Only
points.text: Data is stored exclusively on your device's internal memory. It requires absolutely no internet connection to function.

points.title: Physical Access Security
points.text: Your financial records are as secure as your phone itself. Access is restricted by your device's lock screen pattern or biometrics.

warning.title: Backup Responsibility
warning.text: Since we do not store your data on cloud servers, you are responsible for creating local backups (via Excel export) to prevent data loss if your device is lost or damaged.

finalCTAText: Get ExpenseX on Google Play. One-time purchase, no subscriptions, no ads, no accounts. Take back control of your financial data.

name: PureRemote
tagline: Your phone, your TV, nothing in between. A local-network Android TV remote with no accounts and no cloud.
description: A free, ad-free remote for Android TV and Google TV that talks directly to your TV over your Wi-Fi.
detailedDescription: PureRemote connects your phone straight to your TV over your local network using the Android TV Remote protocol. There are no servers, no accounts, no ads and no analytics. Pair once with a code and the remote is ready.
headline:
A remote should not need a cloud.
It needs a Direct Link.

detailedFeatures.title: Automatic Discovery
detailedFeatures.text: PureRemote finds Android TV and Google TV devices on your Wi-Fi automatically. If your router hides a TV, add it by IP address.

detailedFeatures.title: Simple Pairing
detailedFeatures.text: Pair with the code shown on your TV. Your phone is remembered afterwards, so there is no need to pair again each time.

detailedFeatures.title: D-Pad & Touchpad
detailedFeatures.text: Switch between a classic D-pad and a swipe-friendly touchpad to move around your TV the way you prefer.

detailedFeatures.title: Auto Reconnect
detailedFeatures.text: Reconnects when you return to the app and follows your TV if its address changes after a router restart.

detailedFeatures.title: Encrypted Locally
detailedFeatures.text: Everything between your phone and TV is encrypted with TLS and stays on your local network.

detailedFeatures.title: Free & Ad-Free
detailedFeatures.text: No ads and no paid features. If you like it, an optional one-time tip supports development and unlocks nothing.

points.title: Local Network Only
points.text: The app talks directly to your TV over your Wi-Fi. Pairing data and commands are never sent to the internet.

points.title: Private Pairing Key
points.text: The key that identifies your phone is stored in the app's private storage, and Android cloud backup is turned off for the app.

warning.title: Keep Your Phone Locked
warning.text: Anyone with your unlocked phone can control the TVs you have paired. Forget a TV in the app, or remove your phone in the TV's settings, to revoke access.

finalCTATitle: Turn Your Phone Into a TV Remote
finalCTAText: PureRemote is free, with no ads and no accounts. Pair once and take control of your Android TV or Google TV.
finalCTASubtext: Requires an Android TV or Google TV on the same Wi-Fi
